Container.Name: watchtower-setready
Container.Overview: Virtual Set Ready buttons for a Watchtower 3D-printer farm. One page lists every printer with its state, time left and camera snapshot, and a button to mark the plate cleared or resume a paused print. Open the WebUI and use Settings to enter the Watchtower address and API key. There is no login on the page: anyone on your network who can open it can press the buttons.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port the page is served on.

Config.Name: Settings folder
Config.Description: Holds config.json: the Watchtower address, API key and camera login saved from the page.

Config.Name: Watchtower CA certificate
Config.Description: Optional. Path inside the container to Watchtower's CA certificate (PEM), e.g. /config/watchtower-ca.pem, to verify https properly instead of ticking 'Skip the certificate check'.
